thread:
lia: Quick note: quickstart JS fails on Bun and Deno in CI — import resolution + fetch auth on retries + webcrypto typing. Anyone seen this?

tony: yep saw import errors. Bun complains about resolving '@redwood/sdk' from src/index.js.

mike: usually conditional exports without explicit .js extensions cause that. Deno also needs import_map.

lia: stack: 
```
Error: Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk" from "./src/index.js"
```

jen: also ran into auth header loss on retries in Bun <0.4.9 because Request.clone() didn't keep custom Authorization.

tonY: (typo) Tony: FWIW bumping Bun fixed it for me.

mike: typing: TS complains about crypto.subtle on Deno targets; quick fix is add deno lib refs or guard via (globalThis as any).crypto?.subtle.

jen: short-term sample patch: explicit ESM deep import `@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.js` works, but not ideal.

lia: proposal: update SDK exports to include explicit ESM .js paths, ship both esm/cjs, add import_map + deno example to quickstart, bump sample devDeps, and document runtime minimums (Bun>=0.4.9).

mike: add CI smoke job that runs samples under npm, bun, deno. If failures, auto-file issue.
